name: W
description: W's kit from Arknights for your Helldiver: a mercenary with a grenade launcher, mines and remote bombs, whose blasts freeze enemies in their pose. King of Hearts (Z): a GL-21 with 40 rounds in her hands; each round's blast does 3.5 times its damage and freezes what it catches; her own weapon comes back refilled. Jack in the Box (X): up to 5 charges, each lays a mine under the enemy nearest her aim (or at a random spot ahead); an enemy sets it off. D12 (C): marks enemies, bug holes and structures on her aim line, and B blows the marks. Passives: Artilleryman (her shots burst where they land), Insult to Injury (frozen enemies take more from her), Ambush (while she has not fired for a while, most hits on her miss and enemies see her from less far). Solo or host. Pick W in the character picker on the options screen (F9); her page there has every number and key. Her HUD, the freeze and the markers need Bingus Shared Loader and HD2Runtime. Settings on that page and in w.ini.
